title: Yumurtalı lavaş pide
creator: dytbetulkalli
statusNote: The creator gives no amounts or steps. The ≈ amounts and steps are reconstructed from the video.

items.note: 1 in the filling, part of the other yolk kept for the top

steps: Beat one egg with most of the second (keep a little yolk aside), the tomato, mint and cheese.
Spread the mixture over the middle of the lavash and fold the sides in to make a pide-shaped boat.
Brush the edges with the reserved yolk and sprinkle with sesame and nigella seeds.
Bake or air-fry until the egg is set and the edges are golden.
